stem:
Imani compared the number of fluid ounces per bottle of sunscreen to the cost of four different brands of sunscreen. The information she gathered is shown in the table.

Sunscreen Comparison

| Brand | Number of Fluid Ounces per Bottle | Cost |
|-------|----------------------------------|-------|
| W     | 20                               | $12.00|
| X     | 15                               | $11.25|
| Y     | 10                               | $6.50 |
| Z     | 5                                | $2.50 |

Based on the data in the table, which brand of sunscreen has the greatest cost per fluid ounce?
visual_elements: Table titled Sunscreen Comparison with three columns: Brand, Number of Fluid Ounces per Bottle, Cost. Rows: W 20 $12.00, X 15 $11.25, Y 10 $6.50, Z 5 $2.50.
